proposals.evidence: Turner 8938a identifies Khowar prai gave with the aorist prādāt of pradadāti; 6141 independently specifies Kalasha preterite pra from prādāt. These survey prā give responses preserve that suppletive past stem, despite their generic English gloss, rather than the present/imperative de-/di- stem.
